item_decisions.quote: We issued the Notes on February 26, 2025. Net proceeds of the offering are approximately $1.960 billion, after deducting the underwriting discount and estimated expenses of the offering. We intend to use the net proceeds from the offering of the Notes for general corporate purposes, which may include working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions, stock repurchases or repayment of outstanding indebtedness.

We issued the Notes on August 20, 2025. Net proceeds of the offering are approximately $1.477 billion, after deducting the underwriting discount and estimated expenses of the offering. We intend to use the net proceeds from the offering of the Notes for general corporate purposes, which may include working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions, stock repurchases or repayment of outstanding indebtedness.
